The '''''Tallanx''-class stealth fighter''' was a type of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that saw regular service during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was involved in fighting on [[Ord Gimmel/Legends|Ord Gimmel]]. The ''Tallanx''-class was fast and agile but very lightly armed and designed strictly for swift sneak attacks using its stealth systems to ambush its prey.<ref name="SOR" />
